feature: Design mode puts the UI tools in the tool bar
summary: A new UI design from the front door now opens with a tool bar for building screens: Select, then Frame, Shapes, Pen and Text, then Measure. Every other tool waits under More with its key, and leaving Design gives the full bar back.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no flag changed from its default. Walk: Scripts/playtest/design-mode-tool-strip-walk.json.

try.do: Press Command N, pick the Design UI tile and press New UI canvas.
Rest the pointer on each tool in the bar to read its name and key.
Press F, then R, then T: each picks its tool on the bar.
Press C: Crop is picked from under More, and More lights.
Press Escape, then choose Show Everything from the mode chip.
Choose Design from the chip again: the UI tools come back.

evaluate: Is this the bar you expect when you start a UI design?
When you press C in Design, does a lit More tell you enough about where Crop went?
Should a picture tool you pick by its key in Design join the bar for a while instead of staying under More?
Does it feel right that a recording opened while in Design keeps the video tool bar?
rough: The mock's Component insert tool is not there yet: Photonz has no such tool, and its letter C is Crop's. Filed as a-component-tool-places-a-component-from-the-too.
The mock's Hand tool is not there yet: Photonz pans with space-drag, and H is Highlight's. Filed as a-hand-tool-pans-the-canvas-from-the-tool-bar.
The mock's Zoom button is left out: zoom is not a tool, your call on 2026-09-29.
The Shape slot shows a line until you have used another shape, where the mock draws a square. Filed as the-design-tool-bar-s-shape-slot-shows-a-rectang.

The mock folds Shape, Pen, Text and Measure first when the window is narrow and keeps Hand; Photonz folds the strip from its far end. Matches once Hand exists only if the fold order is revisited; covered by a-hand-tool-pans-the-canvas-from-the-tool-bar.
A document with time keeps the video's tool bar in Design, because the mode is app-wide and a recording still needs its Blade.
